correctness.rationale: The real scalar quartic ratio is homogeneous on the compact ℓ4 unit sphere. Reconstructed stationary condition: all-distinct critical triples have a+b+c=0 and ratio=9; two equal coordinates reduce to f(t)=2(1-t)^4/(2+t^4), whose derivative has critical root t=-cuberoot(2) yielding sharp K=(1+cuberoot2)^3>9. Checked the derivative and zero-sum identity algebraically; applying this scalar bound coordinatewise proves the universal upper bound. Cyclic three-coordinate vectors proportional to (1,1,-cuberoot2) have ℓ4 norm 1 and all three distances K^(1/4). No finite data is used to prove the unbounded-index theorem.
